title: Polylogarithmic circuit depth
statement: For a natural number $d$, a family of directed acyclic circuits has depth bounded by a degree-$d$ polylogarithm if there is a natural number $b$ such that, for every input size $n$, its circuit has depth at most $b( loor{	ext{log}_2 n}+1)^d$.
hypotheses_covered: The degree $d$ is a natural number
The depth bound holds for every natural-number input size $n$
caveat: The floor notation here denotes the natural-number logarithm used in the statement.
